creator: Alexander Terp
description: messaging::a_pane_named_what_a_live_agent_joined_by_is_reached_by_its_callsign failed once in a full gate on 2026-11-13 and passed alone 3 of 3: the test's agent joins as heron, and that run's pane p1 had drawn the callsign heron, so the daemon refused the join ('pane p1 is called heron, and a post to heron reaches the agent in it'). The test should join by a name outside the callsign list, or fix its pane's callsign. Check the other tests in messaging.rs that join by a word from that list.
title: 🎲 A messaging test joins by a name its own pane can draw as a callsign
